minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, June 15, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:08 AM on Wednesday, June 15, 2022.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly

  Members absent: Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist and Yvonne Duran,
  Community Services Manager

  Guests present: Emma Hilario.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, May 18,
  2022 meeting. Motion carried.

  Unfinished Business

2. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, there was an increase to 120
  meals per week in May.

  Meals on Wheels: 762 meals were served to 47 La Verne recipients in May.

3. Guest Speaker: Emma Hilario spoke about her life as an attorney and many other
  interesting positions she has held. She is a candidate for membership in the Senior
  Advisory Committee.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month was $4009.68. An Ad
  in the neighborhood watch may have increased attendance. One person won twice.
  Last game was $150 and it made $180. New caller started and looking to have four
  more callers.

5. Account Balance: $4,630.78.

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid

7. MT. SAC Classes: No registration date is set as of May should be around July 15.
  Watercolor instructor will not be returning. New computers will be all updated at the
  Senior Center
 8. Aging Next: No report.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: End of the fiscal year; nothing outstanding to report. Want to
  replace a light at Veteran’s Hall

10. Community Service Application: Scott made a motion to bring on Emma Hilario as
  permanent member. It was seconded by Terry L Kistler.

11. Upcoming Events:

    Monday, July 4th – Fourth of July
  a. Parade: 10:00AM
  b. Fireworks: Gates open at 5:00PM for 7:00PM show
    Sunday, July 10th– Concert in the Park, 6:30PM
    Monday, July 11th– Movie Matinee, 12:30PM
    Wednesday, July 20th – Excursion: San Juan Capistrano Mission and Historic
  Downtown, 9:15AM
    Sunday, July 24th– Concert in the Park, 6:30PM
    Sunday, July 31st– Movie Night at the Park, 8:15PM
    Tuesday, August 2nd – National Night Out, 4:30PM
    Sunday, August 7th– Concert in the Park, 6:30PM
    Monday, August 8th– Movie Matinee, 12:30PM
    Wednesday, August 10th – Thursday, August 11th – Excursion: A Night in
  Solvang, 9:00AM
    Sunday, August 14th– Movie Night at the Park, 8:15PM
    Tuesday, August 23rd – Excursion: Lake Arrowhead, 9:00AM

12. Public Comments: Senior Advisory Committee will not meet in July.

13. Adjourn: I was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:25 AM Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday August 17, 2022 at 10:00 AM.
